additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407014-DC/Si-D/AE-[Multiple] Alarm is not showing on customer backend CRM:00642002032
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek:
Imagine you have two important letters to mail (let's call them QA26 and SF2). You can only send one letter at a time. The
system
decides which letter to send based on priority:
If one letter is marked as higher priority, that letter will be sent first.
If both letters have the same priority, the system will choose one to send (but we can't predict which one).
So, in your case, either the QA26 message or the SF2 message will be sent to the backend system. The one with higher priority goes first. If they have equal priority, it's somewhat random which one gets sent.
This explains why you might sometimes see QA26 being sent, and other times SF2, depending on how the priorities are set or how the system chooses when priorities are equal. Anyways the Error are both indicating the same outcome.
Does this help clarify the situation? Let me know if you need any further explanation!
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team
